macros.v11:wc:verdict: Replayed with measured compute times on one GPU per system, \sys{}'s Thinker needs 0.65 / 0.80 / 1.20\,s of computation per second of meeting (AMI Zh$\rightarrow$En / En$\rightarrow$Zh / AliMeeting) and its PA Talker 0.18 / 0.26 / 0.31; computation delays the median block's end by a further 3.4 / 2.9 / 52.8\,s, and the delay grows over a meeting, so as implemented (batch-1 decoding that re-encodes the prefix at every read) it does not keep up in real time
macros.v11:wc:app: The Thinker is the bottleneck: reads take longer than the 1\,s cadence 33--45\% of the time and the queue of unprocessed reads builds up in the densest meetings (one AliMeeting meeting needs 1.46\,s per second), while the Talker uses about a third of real time or less. Incremental encoding of the audio prefix (a KV cache across reads) and batching speakers would address the Thinker; we did not implement either.
